v2-1768466685305-0loyvyf0g.name: Aethelgard
v2-1768466685305-0loyvyf0g.description: A sun-drenched land where ancient architectural styles blend with vibrant natural beauty, bathed in the perpetual glow of twilight.

v2-1768466685306-3gcjw1zbs.name: The Azure Coast
v2-1768466685306-3gcjw1zbs.description: A picturesque stretch of coastline known for its unique architectural wonders and vibrant, cascading flora, under a sky of perpetual twilight.

v2-1768466685306-li0rpn72x.name: The Twilit Tower Residence
v2-1768466685306-li0rpn72x.description: A distinctive, multi-storied building with whitewashed, textured walls, featuring numerous arched windows, some with intricate grilles. A prominent tower is topped with a green and white patterned dome. Vibrant purple bougainvillea cascades down one side, and the entrance is marked by a wide archway decorated with blue and white tiles. Palm trees surround the building.

v2-1768466715099-rhy4ou8ql.name: The Twilit Tower Residence
v2-1768466715099-rhy4ou8ql.description: A distinguished, multi-story dwelling characterized by its textured, whitewashed walls, punctuated by arched windows and a striking green and white domed tower. Vibrant floral cascades and tile-adorned entrance add to its exotic charm, set amidst lush palm trees.

v2-1768470341359-ms46rry3v.name: The Rooftop Terrace
v2-1768470341359-ms46rry3v.description: An open-air terrace situated atop The Twilit Tower Residence, offering panoramic views of the twilight cityscape and surrounding coastal mountains. Elegant outdoor seating areas are interspersed with lush potted plants, creating an exclusive urban oasis.

promptLayers.background: The twilight sky with distant coastal mountains, scattered stars, and the faint glow of the city below.
promptLayers.midground: Elegant outdoor seating areas with dark metal frames and plush cushions, interspersed with lush potted plants and architectural elements of the tower's upper level, bordered by clear glass railings.
promptLayers.foreground: The polished, dark wood decking of the terrace, with subtle patterns of shadow and light.
promptLayers.lighting: Soft ambient twilight fading into the warm, inviting glow from the tower's interior windows, with subtle accent lighting on planters.
promptLayers.atmosphere: Tranquil, sophisticated, and breathtaking, with a sense of serene elevation and exclusive comfort.

forbiddenTransformations: sky becoming fully dark or midday bright
seating becoming utilitarian or out of place
glass railings becoming opaque or solid
the terrace floor becoming rough or uneven
internal light sources becoming absent or flickering

v2-1768470797151-f9u9d2usv.name: The Panorama
v2-1768470797151-f9u9d2usv.description: View: The expansive distant view of the twilight cityscape and coastal mountains.
